usage: codex_workflows.py [-h]

Headless Codex worktree orchestration primitives.

positional arguments:
  {agent,watch,status,harvest,cleanup,parallel,pipeline}
    agent               launch one verified headless worker
    watch               watch process exit, then parse logs
    status              print a run manifest
    harvest             copy durable logs and artifacts
    cleanup             remove harvested worktrees
    parallel            launch a validated worker fan-out
    pipeline            run ordered parallel stages
